_doc: Daniel voice cast (docs/daniel/VOICE.md). Schema: tools/story/voice.py docstring; breaths, timbre pinning (mfccRef): tools/story/voice_extras.py.

narrator.instruct: 一位温暖的女讲故事人，像妈妈在床边给四到十岁的孩子讲圣经故事，声音亲切、生动、自然，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。这一句：
narrator.why: the storyteller of Esther and Ruth (Qwen vivian): the family's narrator across packs

daniel.design: 男性，三十五岁左右，温暖、沉稳的男中音，声音柔和干净、略带磁性，说话不急不慢，善良可靠，像一位温和的大哥哥。普通话标准。
daniel.instruct: 像真人在给四到十岁的孩子演圣经故事广播剧，自然不做作，有真实的呼吸，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。这一句：
daniel.why: VoiceDesign warm baritone (audition 109-127 Hz, F0 SD 4.9 st, CER 0.04); no stock Qwen male is free (uncle_fu = Boaz / Esther's king, dylan = Haman, eric misreads in Sichuan accent)

king.instruct: 一位又胖又大的国王，声音洪亮、浑厚、圆润，有王者气派，心肠很软，着急的时候有点滑稽，像真人在演儿童广播剧，自然不做作，语速正常。这一句：
king.why: the only male Qwen voice that stayed one person in the audition (146-161 Hz over 3 lines, F0 SD 6.9 st); the VoiceDesign kings drifted 119-262 Hz

officer.design: 男性，四十岁左右的瘦高个大臣，嗓音尖细、鼻音很重、哼哼唧唧的男高音，说话阴阳怪气、爱抱怨、狡猾，像儿童动画片里滑稽的小坏蛋。普通话标准。
officer.instruct: 像真人在给四到十岁的孩子演圣经故事广播剧，自然不做作，有真实的呼吸，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。这一句：
officer.why: VoiceDesign nasal whiny tenor (audition seed 1: 235-281 Hz, HNR 7.6-15.9, CER 0.00-0.05); not Haman's dylan

daniel.instruct: A calm, warm, kind grown man in his thirties, gentle and steady, a quiet smile in the voice. Like a real actor in a children's Bible radio play for ages 4 to 10: natural, not overacted, with real breaths, at a natural flowing pace. This line:
daniel.why: Qwen ryan: one fixed speaker that takes acting notes (F0 SD 4.1 st, WER 0); Andrew (Boaz) and Christopher (Esther's king) excluded

king.why: deepest and most consistent (100-113 Hz, MFCC spread 18.6), round and breathy (HNR 6.4); phrased for the comic lines

officer.instruct: A jealous, sly, whiny, nasal court official: a comic cartoon villain in a children's radio play, big pitch swings, never scary. This line:
officer.why: Qwen aiden: high (161-311 Hz), lively (F0 SD 4.8 st), a fixed speaker so the giggles and shriek can be split into phrases; not dylan

da_01.m: 讲故事的开头，温暖亲切；说到“大大的巴比伦城”时带一点惊叹；最后一句又软又喜爱
da_01.m_en: storyteller opening, warm and unhurried; a little wonder on 大大的巴比伦城 / 'great city'; soft and fond on the last sentence
da_01.d: 画面：睡前，你翻开一本大图画书，孩子靠在你身边。
da_01.d_en: Picture: bedtime, a big picture book open, the child leaning on you.

phrases.text: there was a man called Daniel.
When he was young he was taken far from home,
to the great city of Babylon.
He loved God more than anything,
and he prayed to Him every day.

da_02.m: 又大又暖的国王，很满意他的好朋友；说“我都放心”时带着笑；最后一句气派十足
da_02.m_en: a big, warm king, pleased with his friend; generous, a laugh in the voice on 我都放心 / 'anything'; grand on the last sentence
da_02.d: 画面：你拍着好朋友的肩膀，夸他是最棒的。
da_02.d_en: Picture: you pat your best friend on the shoulder and tell him he's the best.

zh.asrIgnore: 哈|哼|哇|啊|嘿|呵|哦|唔|嗯|唉|呃|嘘

phrases.text: I can trust you with anything!
I'm going to put you in charge of my whole kingdom!

da_03.m: 谦虚、平静，一位和善的成年男子，带着微笑；最后半句轻一点、真诚
da_03.m_en: humble and calm, a kind grown-up man; a small smile; slower on the last phrase
da_03.d: 画面：别人夸你，你笑着说“这不是我的功劳”。
da_03.d_en: Picture: someone praises you and you smile: 'it wasn't really me'.

da_04.m: 嫉妒、生闷气，鼻音重，哼哼唧唧；先重重地“哼”一声；“找啊找”说得快；最后一句委屈地哀叫
da_04.m_en: sulky, jealous, a bit whiny; a loud 哼 / 'hmph' first; speeds up on 找啊找 / 'looked and looked'; exasperated wail on the last words
da_04.d: 画面：别的小朋友得了小红花，你没得，气得跺脚。
da_04.d_en: Picture: another child got the gold star, not you, and you stamp your foot.

phrases.instruct: 鼻子里重重地“哼”一声，气鼓鼓的，像生闷气的小孩，是一个声音，不是念字。

phrases.text: 凭什么是他？我找啊找，找他的毛病……
一个都找不到！他太老实了！
phrases.instruct: 委屈地哀叫起来，像小孩耍赖，越说越尖。

zh.asrIgnore: 哈|哼|哇|啊|嘿|呵|哦|唔|嗯|唉|呃|嘘

phrases.instruct: A loud, sulky snort through the nose, like a cross child: a sound, not a word.

phrases.text: Why him? I looked and looked for something he did wrong...
and I couldn't find a thing! He's too honest!
phrases.instruct: An exasperated, whiny wail, rising higher and higher.

en.pickWhy: the auto pick had no 'Hmph' at all (asrIgnore forgives a missing interjection); take 3 has it, F0 SD 4.15

da_05.m: 一边想一边放慢，眼睛一亮；“嘿嘿”是真的偷笑出声；最后一句压低声音、得意又调皮
da_05.m_en: sly, slowing down as the idea comes; a sneaky giggle; whispered and cheeky on the end
da_05.d: 画面：你想到一个恶作剧，捂着嘴偷偷笑。
da_05.d_en: Picture: you've thought of a prank and giggle behind your hand.

phrases.text: 等等……他天天向他的上帝祷告。

phrases.instruct: 捂着嘴偷偷坏笑出声：真的在笑，有气声，不是一个字一个字念“嘿嘿”。
压低声音，又得意又调皮，像说悄悄话。

zh.asrIgnore: 哈|哼|哇|啊|嘿|呵|哦|唔|嗯|唉|呃|嘘
zh.pickWhy: take 0 (7.4 s, real 嘿嘿 giggle, top score 8.05) lost only on whisper hearing 啦 for 了; the auto pick (take 4) dragged to 11.8 s with an extra 哈哈哈哈

phrases.text: Wait a minute... he prays to his God every day.

phrases.instruct: A real sneaky giggle behind the hand, breathy: actually laughing, not reading the words.
A cheeky, gleeful whisper.

en.pickWhy: the only take with a real giggle (laugh score 4.7) lost on whisper writing 'Pfft' for 'Heh heh'

da_06.m: 油腔滑调地拍马屁，一边鞠躬；“伟大的王”说得特别夸张；后面又快又急；说到“狮子坑”带一点坏坏的得意
da_06.m_en: oily, over-sweet flattery, bowing; big on 伟大的王 / 'great King'; then quick and pushy; a wicked little relish on 狮子坑 / 'lions'
da_06.d: 画面：你想要一块糖，拼命夸妈妈最漂亮。
da_06.d_en: Picture: you want a sweet, so you tell Mum she's the most beautiful mum ever.

da_07.m: 被夸得飘飘然，有点得意，呵呵笑；“嗯”是在想；“盖章！”干脆又高兴
da_07.m_en: flattered and a little vain, chuckling; a thinking 嗯 / 'hmm'; brisk and pleased on 盖章 / 'Seal it'
da_07.d: 画面：有人夸你，你挺起胸膛说“那当然！”
da_07.d_en: Picture: someone flatters you and you puff out your chest: 'Of course!'

phrases.instruct: 摸着下巴想一想，“嗯——”是一个拖长的鼻音，不是念字。
呵呵笑着，干脆又高兴。

zh.asrIgnore: 哈|哼|哇|啊|嘿|呵|哦|唔|嗯|唉|呃|嘘

da_08.m: 安静、佩服；“可他还是”后面停一下；“一天三次”稳稳地说
da_08.m_en: quiet and admiring; a small pause after 可他还是 / 'But'; steady and slow on 一天三次 / 'three times a day'
da_08.d: 画面：每天睡前，你都一样跪在床边祷告。
da_08.d_en: Picture: every night, the same way, you kneel by the bed to pray.

phrases.text: Daniel heard about the new law.
he went home just as he always did,

da_09.m: 真正的祷告，轻轻的、贴近的，不说教；平静、信靠；“可你是”之前吸一口气；“也帮助我们的王”温柔善良
da_09.m_en: a real prayer, soft and close, not preachy; calm, trusting; a breath before 可你是 / 'but You are'; gentle and kind on 也帮助我们的王
da_09.d: 画面：你小声跟上帝说心里话。
da_09.d_en: Picture: you whisper what's in your heart to God.

da_10.m: 先压低声音说悄悄话，又兴奋又坏；“嘿嘿嘿”是真的坏笑出声；最后一句又快又急
da_10.m_en: whisper at first, gleeful and nasty; rising to a nasty little cackle; quick and excited at the end
da_10.d: 画面：你躲在门后，发现了别人的秘密。
da_10.d_en: Picture: hiding behind a door, you've just found out someone's secret.

phrases.text: 嘘——看！他在祷告！抓到你了吧！
phrases.instruct: 压低声音说悄悄话，又兴奋又坏。
忍不住坏笑出声，嘿嘿嘿地笑，有气声，越笑越得意，不是念字。
又快又急，兴奋地要跑去告状。

zh.asrIgnore: 哈|哼|哇|啊|嘿|呵|哦|唔|嗯|唉|呃|嘘|嘶

phrases.text: Shh! Look! He's praying! Got you now!
phrases.instruct: An excited, nasty whisper.
A nasty little cackle that bursts out: real laughter with breath, not reading the words.

phrases.text: I'm going straight to the king!
phrases.instruct: Quick and excited, already running off to tell.

da_11.m: 告状，得意洋洋，手指着人；又快又尖
da_11.m_en: tattling, triumphant, pointing; fast and shrill
da_11.d: 画面：你跑去跟老师告状：“他犯规了！”
da_11.d_en: Picture: you run to the teacher: 'He broke the rule!'

da_12.m: 先吃一惊，然后着急慌乱；“不行不行”脱口而出；后半句下决心，但心里害怕
da_12.m_en: shocked, then upset and fumbling; the 不行不行 / 'no, no' tumbles out; determined but afraid on the last half
da_12.d: 画面：你听说好朋友要被罚，急得团团转。
da_12.d_en: Picture: you hear your best friend is in trouble and you can't keep still.

phrases.text: I have to find a way to save him!

da_13.m: 假装有礼貌，阴阳怪气、拖着唱腔；最后的“哦”拖长，坏坏的
da_13.m_en: smug, sing-song, mock-polite; a nasty little 哦 / 'never' at the end
da_13.d: 画面：你提醒别人“你答应过的哦”，心里偷着乐。
da_13.d_en: Picture: you remind someone 'you promised!' and grin inside.

zh.asrIgnore: 哈|哼|哇|啊|嘿|呵|哦|唔|嗯|唉|呃|嘘

da_14.m: 长长的一声“唉”，真心后悔，快要哭了
da_14.m_en: a long groan of regret, real sorrow, almost tearful
da_14.d: 画面：你做错了事，后悔得抱住头。
da_14.d_en: Picture: you did something wrong and hold your head in your hands.

phrases.instruct: 长长地、沉沉地叹一口气，真心后悔，是叹气声，不是念字。
后悔得快要哭了，声音发颤。

zh.asrIgnore: 哈|哼|哇|啊|嘿|呵|哦|唔|嗯|唉|呃|嘘

phrases.text: how could I be so foolish!

da_15.m: 低沉、严肃，但温柔，不吓人
da_15.m_en: low and serious, but gentle; not scary
da_15.d: 画面：天快黑了，故事讲到最难的地方。
da_15.d_en: Picture: it's getting dark; the story reaches the hard part.

phrases.text: Daniel was taken to the lions' den.

da_16.m: 哽咽，但充满盼望；“但以理”声音一颤；“一定会救你”坚定
da_16.m_en: choked up but full of hope; a catch in the voice on 但以理; firm and sure on 一定会救你
da_16.d: 画面：你送好朋友远行，眼泪在打转，还给他打气。
da_16.d_en: Picture: seeing your friend off on a hard trip, tears in your eyes, cheering him on.

phrases.text: the God you serve every day...

da_17.m: 平安，安慰国王；安静的力量，带着微笑
da_17.m_en: peaceful, comforting the king; quiet strength, a small smile
da_17.d: 画面：你拍拍害怕的妹妹：“别怕，我在。”
da_17.d_en: Picture: you pat your scared little sister: 'Don't worry, I'm here.'

en.pickWhy: take 0 dragged a 9-word line to 6.7 s (pace 1.8); take 3 is 5.7 s with the same pitch movement (F0 SD 4.1)

da_18.m: 压低声音，有点悬念，“慢慢走过来”轻轻地说；说到“没有害怕”又平静温暖
da_18.m_en: hushed and suspenseful, slow on 慢慢走过来 / 'crept closer'; then calm and warm on 没有害怕 / 'wasn't afraid'
da_18.d: 画面：关了灯，你给孩子讲故事讲到最紧张的地方。
da_18.d_en: Picture: lights off, you reach the most exciting part of the bedtime story.

phrases.text: It was dark in the den.

da_19.m: 说到光时惊奇、敬畏；然后越来越开心，“大哈欠”“呼噜呼噜”笑出来，俏皮
da_19.m_en: wonder on the light (slow, awed), then a delighted giggle building through 大哈欠 / 'big yawn' to 呼噜呼噜 / 'purred'; playful and happy
da_19.d: 画面：一只大狮子像小猫一样打呼噜，你忍不住笑。
da_19.d_en: Picture: a huge lion purring like a kitten, and you can't help laughing.

zh.asrIgnore: 哈|哼|哇|啊|嘿|呵|哦|唔|嗯|唉|呃|嘘

phrases.text: God sent an angel to shut the lions' mouths.
the lion gave a great big yawn,
and purred like a giant kitty cat!

da_20.m: 有点好笑又有点心疼，像讲一个操心太多的大人
da_20.m_en: a little funny-sad, like telling about a grown-up who worries too much
da_20.d: 画面：爸爸半夜睡不着，在屋里走来走去。
da_20.d_en: Picture: Dad can't sleep and walks up and down the house at night.

da_21.m: 翻来覆去，焦急，先叹一大口气；第二个“睡不着”像小孩一样哼哼唧唧，滑稽
da_21.m_en: restless, fretting, a big tired sigh; a comic whimper on the second 睡不着 / 'can't sleep'
da_21.d: 画面：你明天要去春游，兴奋得睡不着。
da_21.d_en: Picture: it's the night before the school trip and you just can't sleep.

phrases.instruct: 疲惫地、长长地叹一大口气，是叹气声，不是念字。

phrases.text: 但以理怎么样了？睡不着，
phrases.instruct: 翻来覆去，又着急又困。
像小孩一样哼哼唧唧地抱怨，滑稽，带一点哭腔。

zh.asrIgnore: 哈|哼|哇|啊|嘿|呵|哦|唔|嗯|唉|呃|嘘

da_22.m: 一路跑来，气喘吁吁，着急，大声朝坑里喊；问的时候声音发颤
da_22.m_en: out of breath from running, anxious, calling loudly into the den; voice cracks with worry on the question
da_22.d: 画面：你在操场上大声喊找不到的小狗。
da_22.d_en: Picture: you're calling for your lost puppy across the playground.

zh.asrIgnore: 哈|哼|哇|啊|嘿|呵|哦|唔|嗯|唉|呃|嘘

da_23.m: 从坑里朝上喊，开心，带着笑声；响亮明亮
da_23.m_en: joyful and calling up from the den, a happy laugh in it; strong and bright
da_23.d: 画面：捉迷藏你被找到了，大声说“我在这儿！”
da_23.d_en: Picture: found in hide-and-seek, you shout 'I'm here!'

zh.asrIgnore: 哈|哼|哇|啊|嘿|呵|哦|唔|嗯|唉|呃|嘘

da_24.m: 大大松了一口气，笑出来，高兴地指挥；“快，快”说得急
da_24.m_en: huge relief, laughing, bossy-happy; quick 快快 / 'quick, quick'
da_24.d: 画面：你找到了丢的小狗，高兴得跳起来。
da_24.d_en: Picture: you've found your lost puppy and jump for joy.

zh.asrIgnore: 哈|哼|哇|啊|嘿|呵|哦|唔|嗯|唉|呃|嘘

da_25.m: 高兴，有点惊奇；最后一句温暖、稳稳地说
da_25.m_en: glad, a little amazed; slow and warm on the last sentence
da_25.d: 画面：你摔了一跤，爬起来一看，一点都没破皮。
da_25.d_en: Picture: you fell over, got up, and there isn't a scratch on you.

phrases.text: Daniel walked out of the lions' den

da_26.m: 被抓住了，紧张、嘟嘟囔囔，假装若无其事；声音越来越小
da_26.m_en: caught out, nervous, mumbling, trying to sound casual; trails off
da_26.d: 画面：你偷吃饼干被发现，想悄悄溜走。
da_26.d_en: Picture: caught with your hand in the biscuit tin, you try to slip away.

zh.asrIgnore: 哈|哼|哇|啊|嘿|呵|哦|唔|嗯|唉|呃|嘘

da_27.m: 卡通式的尖叫，吓得魂都飞了，声音又高又尖，一边跑一边越来越远
da_27.m_en: a high, comic shriek of fright, cartoon-style; it trails away as he runs
da_27.d: 画面：一只大狗朝你冲过来，你尖叫着逃跑。
da_27.d_en: Picture: a big dog runs at you and you flee, shrieking.

phrases.instruct: 短促的卡通式尖叫“哇啊啊——”：吓得魂都飞了，声音又高又尖，一两秒就停，真的在尖叫，不是念字。
一边拼命逃跑一边尖声大喊救命。

zh.asrIgnore: 哈|哼|哇|啊|嘿|呵|哦|唔|嗯|唉|呃|嘘

phrases.instruct: A high, long cartoon shriek of pure fright, really screaming, held and piercing, not reading the word.
Shrieking for help while running away in a panic.

en.pickWhy: the auto pick said only 'Help!' (shriek 1.4 read); take 0 is a held shriek (3.4) + 'help', 2.5 s

da_28.m: 国王的大宣告，但很欢喜，不严厉；张开双臂；响亮、有力
da_28.m_en: a king's big proclamation, but joyful, not stern; arms open; strong and ringing
da_28.d: 画面：你站在高处，对全世界大声宣布好消息。
da_28.d_en: Picture: you stand up high and shout good news to the whole world.

phrases.text: Hear this, everyone in my kingdom!
Daniel's God is the living God!
and He keeps His people safe!

da_29.m: 温暖的结尾，直接对孩子说；最后一句带着微笑
da_29.m_en: warm moral, speaking right to the child; smile on the last sentence
da_29.d: 画面：故事讲完了，你摸摸孩子的头。
da_29.d_en: Picture: the story is over and you stroke the child's hair.

phrases.text: You can talk to God any time too.
